name: Domain Search for WHMCS
author: Shipon Karmakar

sections.description:
Domain Search for WHMCS is a lightweight yet powerful WordPress plugin that allows users to search for domain names and redirects them to your WHMCS-powered domain registration portal. This seamless integration improves user experience and streamlines domain purchase processes.

Key Features:

  • Simple and fast domain search form
  • Fully customizable search field and placeholder text
  • Shortcode support for easy placement anywhere on your website
  • Redirect users to your WHMCS domain registration page automatically
  • Admin settings page for easy configuration
  • Lightweight and optimized for speed
  • Secure nonce verification for form submissions
  • Supports multiple domain search shortcodes with custom settings
  • Easy deletion and management of created shortcodes
  • Optimized code for better WordPress compatibility

This plugin is perfect for web hosting businesses, domain resellers, and WHMCS-based service providers looking to enhance user engagement and conversion rates.
sections.installation:
1. Download and install the plugin via the WordPress dashboard or upload it manually to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Domain Search for WHMCS to configure your WHMCS domain search URL.
  4. Use the shortcode [domain_search_for_whmcs] to display the search form anywhere on your site.
  5. You can create multiple domain search shortcodes with custom URLs and placeholder text from the admin panel.
sections.faq:
How do I change the WHMCS URL?

Go to Settings > Domain Search for WHMCS and update the WHMCS domain search URL field.

Can I customize the placeholder text?

Yes! The placeholder text can be customized from the settings page.

Does this plugin work with any WordPress theme?

Absolutely! The plugin is designed to be compatible with any WordPress theme.

Is it SEO-friendly?

Yes! The plugin is lightweight and does not slow down your site, ensuring optimal performance for SEO.

Can I create multiple search forms with different URLs?

Yes! You can add multiple shortcodes with different WHMCS URLs and placeholder texts from the settings page.

How do I delete a shortcode?

Navigate to Settings > Domain Search for WHMCS, find the shortcode you want to remove, and click delete.
